# laravelcloud_filesystem_keys (Resource)

Manages a filesystem key in Laravel Cloud.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "laravelcloud_filesystem_keys" "example" {
  filesystem = "filesystem-id"
  name       = "example-name"
  permission = "read_write"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `filesystem` (String) The filesystem this resource belongs to.
- `name` (String)
- `permission` (String)

### Optional

- `filesystem_key` (String) The filesystem key identifier

### Read-Only

- `access_key_id` (String)
- `access_key_secret` (String, Sensitive)
- `created_at` (String)
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import laravelcloud_filesystem_keys.example filesystem-id/the-id
```
